semiconductor_relevance: High — IRE SEMITEC specializes in semiconductor testing solutions, particularly in the production of probe needles and low leakage probe cards.
summary: IRE SEMITEC CO., LTD is a leading provider of semiconductor testing solutions, focusing on ultra-fine processing technology for probe needles and probe cards. With over 20 years of experience, the company emphasizes R&D and quality assurance to meet the demands of clients in various regions.
capabilities: Production of probe needles for semiconductor EDS inspection equipment
Development of low leakage probe cards using patented platinum needle technology
Implementation of Auto Vision Inspection System (AVIS) for quality management
